privacy.header.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what the Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers chapter at Colorado Mesa University (SHPE @ CMU) collects through this website, why, who helps us handle it, and how you can delete it. We are a student club: we collect as little as we can and never sell your information.
privacy.collect.heading: What we collect
privacy.use.heading: Why we collect it
privacy.processors.heading: Who helps us handle it
privacy.processors.intro: These service providers process data only to run this site for us. We don’t sell or share your information with anyone else, including advertisers, unless the law requires it.
privacy.cookies.heading: Cookies
privacy.cookies.body: We only use cookies that are strictly necessary to sign you in and keep you signed in securely, so there is no cookie banner. We don’t use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. Your light or dark theme choice is saved in your own browser and never sent to us.
privacy.retention.heading: How long we keep it
privacy.choices.heading: Your choices
privacy.children.heading: Children
privacy.children.body: This site is not directed to children under 13, and you must be 13 or older to create an account. If you believe a child under 13 has given us information, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.changes.heading: Changes to this policy
privacy.changes.body: If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page. If a change affects how we use information you already gave us, we will email account holders first.
privacy.contact.heading: Contact us
privacy.contact.body: Questions about your information or this policy? Email us:
terms.header.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of the SHPE @ Colorado Mesa University website and your account on it. By creating an account you agree to them. They are meant to be short and plain; if anything is unclear, ask us.
terms.accounts.heading: Your account
terms.accounts.body: You must be 13 or older to create an account. Use your real name and an email address you control, keep your password to yourself, and tell us if you think someone else has used your account. You are responsible for what happens under your account.
terms.use.heading: Acceptable use
terms.use.intro: Please use this site the way it is meant to be used. Don’t:
terms.termination.heading: Ending your account
terms.termination.body: You can delete your account at any time from your account page. We may suspend or delete an account that breaks these terms, and we may change or shut down the site, for example if the chapter stops running it.
terms.warranty.heading: No warranty
terms.warranty.body: This site is run by student volunteers and is provided as is. We do our best to keep it working and accurate, but we can’t promise it will always be available or error-free, and to the extent the law allows we aren’t liable for losses caused by using it.
terms.changes.heading: Changes to these terms
terms.changes.body: If we change these terms, we will update the date at the top of this page. Continuing to use your account after a change means you accept the new terms.
terms.contact.heading: Contact us
terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms? Email us:
